extracted.intended_audience: scholars and students of political communication and public opinion research
extracted.subtask_description: Criteria for high-quality experimental research reporting in political science—what makes a study/report persuasive, careful, and publishable (e.g., articulation of hypotheses, methodological detail, clear data presentation).

rubrics_metrics.name: Clear articulation of hypotheses
rubrics_metrics.guidance: From review: 'Hypotheses are expressly articulated' — implies that strong research reports state explicit testable hypotheses up front so readers understand the claims being evaluated.

rubrics_metrics.name: Careful and detailed methodology
rubrics_metrics.guidance: From review and book description: 'methodology carefully detailed' and the authors 'documented a series of sophisticated and innovative experiments' and 'put together a complex, integrated system of experiments' — guidance: provide thorough procedural detail about experiments (design, manipulation, sampling, controls) so results are reproducible and credible.

rubrics_metrics.name: Clear presentation of data
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Quoted praise: 'data clearly presented' — implies use of transparent tables/figures, described distributions, sample sizes, and analytic steps so readers can follow and evaluate evidence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Convincing explanation of results
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Review: 'best of all often convincingly explained' — beyond presenting data, authors should interpret findings with logical arguments linking evidence to claims, consider alternative explanations, and show why the interpretation is plausible.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cautious and carefully presented conclusions
rubrics_metrics.description: Conclusions are carefully and cautiously presented.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Choice review: 'The conclusions are carefully and cautiously presented' — guidance: avoid overclaiming, acknowledge limitations, and delimit the scope of inference.

rubrics_metrics.name: Innovative and ingenious experimental design
rubrics_metrics.description: Use of ingenious, sophisticated, and innovative experiments to test effects.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: American Political Science Review: 'numerous ingenious experiments' and book description: 'unobtrusively altered the order and emphasis of news stories' — guidance: employ creative manipulations that capture real-world processes while maintaining experimental control.

rubrics_metrics.name: Integration of experimental and survey evidence
rubrics_metrics.description: Findings backed by careful analysis of public opinion surveys in addition to experiments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Book blurb: 'Backed by careful analysis of public opinion surveys' — guidance: triangulate experimental results with survey data to bolster external validity and show population-level relevance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Readable and lucid writing
rubrics_metrics.description: Lucidly written and accessible presentation of complex research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Review: 'a lucidly written work deserving widespread attention' — guidance: present methods and results in clear prose, organize argumentation well, and make complex experimental systems comprehensible to readers.
